product_metadata.title: LANGRIA Wire Cube Plastic Connectors for Modular Organizer Closet and Wire Grid Cube Storage Shelving Unit, Set of 8 (Black)
features: The package includes a total of 8 black connectors
The plastic connectors are made of resistant ABS to securely join the panels
Compatible with LANGRIA modular closet and LANGRIA wire grid modular cubes
Each connector has 8 slots for panel corners; the inner width of each slot is 4mm
Easy to install and attach to the panels; you can put the panels together, take them apart and reconfigure as many times as needed
description: Easy and fast way to build up your modular units

Set of 8 black plastic connectors compatible with LANGRIA cubes modular storage system as well as LANGRIA wire grid modular storage system. These connectors are very easy to assemble and take apart within minutes and without extra tools. Pull together your modular closets and be sure that these connectors are sturdy enough to keep the panels together without wobbling.

these connectors are for LANGRIA cube panels and grid panels only. We cannot guarantee that they will fit other brands’ modular closets. All dimensions are measured manually with a possible deviation of 1-2 mm.
